values: Meridian AWS-first cloud consumption evidence workbook

Lead with AWS evidence: Cost and Usage Report, Savings Plans and RI coverage, CloudWatch or Compute Optimizer, AWS Organizations, AP invoices, and EDP terms. Azure is included only as a comparator to prove the model is portable.

This is not a replacement for AWS Cost Explorer or Compute Optimizer. Those tools produce native AWS telemetry. Nexus integrates that telemetry with contracts, AP-paid invoices, CMDB applications, owner tags, evidence lineage, and sourcing action governance.
AWS is the hero contract. Azure is present as a secondary comparator.
1. Start with AWS payer account spend and confirm it reconciles to AP-paid invoices.
Twelve AP-reconciled months for each contract.
2. Show persistent EC2 and RDS spend still running on demand despite committed-use options.
Provider-native service spend broken down by app/account/service.
3. Connect those workloads to clinical and patient digital applications in CMDB.
Resources with utilization and rightsize signals.
4. Read the EDP/Savings Plan terms before turning a FinOps recommendation into a sourcing action.
Action rows with candidate value, not finance-confirmed savings.
5. aVa may explain the AWS candidate, but must not call it realized savings until finance confirms.
Total candidate action amount. Finance state remains not_confirmed.
Cost and Usage Report exported to S3
Monthly service/account/application spend and on-demand vs covered split
Native AWS data is evidence, not the final commercial claim.
Savings Plans and RI utilization CSV/API
Stable eligible spend, coverage, utilization, step-up opportunity
Nexus adds contract term and AP reconciliation context.
Owner/app criticality must be known before action.
Monthly spend by subscription, service, meter, tag, application
Azure Cost Management supplies facts. Nexus connects them to sourcing action.
Idle or underutilized resources, SKU, owner and app tags
Recommendations remain candidates until owner validates impact.
EA, EDP, private pricing, support addendum
Commitments, notice, benchmark rights, exit and support terms
The PDF defines obligations. It does not prove usage or paid spend.
Cloud vendor invoice and payment extract
Paid amount and variance against cloud billing export
Nexus will not call spend paid until AP confirms it.
Which workloads and business owners consume cloud spend
This turns technical spend into accountable business spend.
Shows cloud spend, service mix, coverage, utilization, recommendations.
Does not know contract notice dates, AP payment state, business owner approval, or sourcing action state.
Ingest as source evidence and reconcile with CLM, ERP/AP and CMDB.
Does not decide whether clinical or production workload owners can accept the change.
Adds app criticality, owner, scope and approval gates before action.
Shows commitment utilization and uncovered eligible spend.
Does not prove whether the buyer should negotiate, step up, reduce scope or change contract terms.
Connects coverage to EDP/EA terms and renewal strategy.
Do not prove paid amount, GL allocation, or finance-confirmed value.
Reconciles cloud bill to AP payment before any realized-value claim.
